```plato

// A doubly symmetric I (wide-flange) section. Depth is the overall height
// between flange outer faces.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I-beam)
type IBeamSection
    implements IValue
{
    Depth: Length;
    FlangeWidth: Length;
    FlangeThickness: Length;
    WebThickness: Length;
}

// A C-shaped channel section. Depth is the overall height; flanges project to
// one side of the web.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Structural_channel)
type ChannelSection
    implements IValue
{
    Depth: Length;
    FlangeWidth: Length;
    FlangeThickness: Length;
    WebThickness: Length;
}

// A T-shaped section: one flange with a central stem. Depth is the overall
// height including the flange.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/T-beam)
type TSection
    implements IValue
{
    Depth: Length;
    FlangeWidth: Length;
    FlangeThickness: Length;
    StemThickness: Length;
}

// An L-shaped (angle) section with two legs of uniform thickness.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Structural_steel)
type AngleSection
    implements IValue
{
    LegA: Length;
    LegB: Length;
    Thickness: Length;
}

// Analysis-ready properties of a cross-section about its centroidal axes.
// Centroid is in meters in the section plane. Second moments and the torsion
// constant are in meters to the fourth power; section moduli are in cubic
// meters. Y and Z are the section's principal in-plane axes.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Second_moment_of_area)
type SectionProperties
    implements IValue
{
    Area: Area;
    Centroid: Point2D;
    SecondMomentY: Number;
    SecondMomentZ: Number;
    ProductMoment: Number;
    TorsionConstant: Number;
    SectionModulusY: Number;
    SectionModulusZ: Number;
}
```
